subject.title: fix(agents): add lock release timeout on attempt teardown

question: Which retained session lock recovery contract should this PR use when disposal is still not idle after the teardown timeout?
rationale: Force-release, contender-side reclaim, and deferring to existing maxHoldMs have different transcript-concurrency and session-state safety tradeoffs that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Require safe release before merge
options.body: Ask this PR or a replacement to make the timeout path actually free the write lock for the reported alive same-process failure, with regression coverage and live proof.

options.title: Accept timeout-only teardown
options.body: Ship the timeout only as a partial teardown-progress mitigation and keep the linked stuck-session issue open for a real recovery contract.

options.title: Consolidate with lock-policy work
options.body: Route the recovery contract through the broader maxHold/live-holder reclaim work if maintainers want one canonical lock policy.

recommendation.title: Require safe release before merge
recommendation.body: Ask this PR or a replacement to make the timeout path actually free the write lock for the reported alive same-process failure, with regression coverage and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history in session-lock policy and embedded-attempt lock lifecycle paths.
